prompt:
make me a website tracking GPU prices

Build this as a simple single-page static site:
- One self-contained index.html with all CSS and JS inline.
- No backend, server, or build step — static files only.
- Inline all assets; keep it lightweight and responsive.
summary: A single self-contained static page that lets shoppers eyeball current and historical street prices for popular desktop GPUs (RTX 5090/5080/4070, RX 7900 XTX/7800 XT, Arc B580, etc.) across a few major retailers, with sortable/filterable cards and a lightweight inline sparkline chart per card. Since the prompt explicitly rules out a backend, build step, or database, the only primitive needed is a static_site: all data is a hardcoded JS array of seed price snapshots baked into the single index.html, all styling is inline CSS, and all interactivity (search, sort, filter by brand/vendor, tiny canvas sparklines) is inline vanilla JS. No web_service, postgres, or key_value is justified because nothing needs to run per-request, persist writes, or survive beyond a page load — the "tracking" is illustrative seed data, not a live feed.
